From checkout to activation in three steps
1
Buy on this page
Checkout opens right here via Gumroad — no Apple ID required.
2
Get your license key by email
Your key is sent from licenses@storageradar.app within minutes after checkout. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.
3
Activate in the Direct build
Open Settings → Purchases & Updates, click Open Paywall, then use Paste Key → Activate License Key. The key is tied to your purchase, not an Apple ID.
What the Direct build does not do
It never asks you to sign in on this website.
Your purchase and license key never require an Apple ID.
It does not auto-delete anything — every removal is your decision.
It makes no performance or speed claims.
Direct purchase — questions
How is the Direct build different from the App Store version?
The Direct build gets broader macOS access for advanced and developer cleanup that sandboxing limits on the App Store. It's the same review-first disk space analyzer — bought outside the App Store and activated with a license key.
Do I need an Apple ID?
No — the purchase and your license key never require an Apple ID or an account on this site.
How do I get my license key?
Your key is emailed from licenses@storageradar.app within minutes after checkout. Check your spam folder if needed, then open Settings → Purchases & Updates, click Open Paywall, and use Paste Key → Activate License Key.
Can I get a refund?
Yes — you have 14 days from purchase to request a full refund through Gumroad.
I already bought on the App Store — do I pay again?
No — existing App Store customers can unlock the Direct build for free. See the crossgrade page for details.
